verdict.rationale: Jitsu ships a first-party webhook destination that sends event data to any HTTP endpoint. A programmatic consumer can register its own URL and receive events, which goes beyond the Slack and Discord chat targets. Separately, Email/Slack failure alerts do not count, and the OTLP log export is adjacent rather than webhook support. Missing for 10: documented payload format, retry/delivery guarantees and request signing for the webhook destination, webhook subscriptions to platform/pipeline events (e.g., sync failures), and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can subscribe to events via webhooks

citations.quote: Send data to any HTTP endpoint. You can use this destination to send data to Slack, Discord, or any other service that accepts HTTP requests.
